def get_2019_video_games():
    import requests
    url = "https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php"
    params = {
        "action": "query",
        "list": "categorymembers",
        "cmtitle": "Category:2019_video_games",
        "cmlimit": "max",
        "format": "json"
    }
    response = requests.get(url, params=params)
    data = response.json()
    games = [member["title"] for member in data["query"]["categorymembers"]]
    return games
